title: Mach2: Scientific Discovery Platform with Deterministic Execution Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2611.14777v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-model agents can formulate workflows and invoke specialized tools, yet compliance with natural-language operating rules is not guaranteed by prompting alone. Mach2 addresses this limitation by coupling Eigen orchestration to deterministic, lint-like checks of tool requests, source changes, acceptance tests, and artifact contracts. Domain requirements are represented as executable predicates: mandatory failures prevent advancement of the checked operation, while diagnostic findings are retained for correction or review. User-specified test-driven development (TDD), CodeGrapher's abstract-syntax-tree analysis, and history-guided evolutionary search provide complementary verification and optimization mechanisms. Mach2 also generates task-specific agent packages for execution through independently selected endpoints. The originating harness validates returned artifacts against declared interfaces and evidence requirements without

translated_title: Mach2：具有确定性执行约束的科学发现平台
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.14777v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：语言模型智能体能够制定工作流程并调用专用工具，但仅靠提示词无法保证其遵守自然语言形式的操作规则。Mach2 通过将 Eigen 编排与确定性的、类似代码检查（lint）的验证机制相耦合来解决这一局限，对工具请求、源代码变更、验收测试以及工件契约进行检查。领域需求被表示为可执行的谓词：强制性失败会阻止被检查操作继续推进，而诊断结果则被保留下来以供修正或审查。用户指定的测试驱动开发（TDD）、CodeGrapher 的抽象语法树分析以及历史引导的进化搜索，共同提供了互补的验证与优化机制。此外，Mach2 还能生成面向特定任务的智能体软件包，并通过独立选择的端点加以执行。发起方的执行框架会依据已声明的接口和证据要求对返回的工件进行验证，而无需……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: Mach2 的核心创新在于将语言模型智能体的编排与确定性的类 lint 可执行检查相结合，把领域需求转化为覆盖工具请求、代码变更、验收测试和工件契约的可执行谓词，从而强制保证智能体遵守操作规则，弥补了仅靠提示词无法确保合规的缺陷。
en_tdlr: Mach2 couples LLM agent orchestration with deterministic, lint-like executable checks of tool requests, source changes, acceptance tests, and artifact contracts, guaranteeing compliance with operating rules that prompting alone cannot ensure.
